Name: (CP) Sam's New Mullet
Author: BugboyBehaviour
Description:
Hello! Sam's new mullet is a portrait mod that grants Sam a better mullet, to fix whatever super-saiyan bullshit he had going on before. Only changes portraits, does NOT affect overworld sprites.

If you want a mod that changes Sam's overworld sprite in a similar fashion to this one, I HIGHLY recommend the sam mullet replacement created by Rosenbug. This mod was made to compliment it! You'll find it in the mod requirements.

-------

The most notable change made by this mod is Sam's mullet, but it also changes his eye color from blue to green so it matches his overworld sprites slightly better. 

There are two versions of this mod you can download: 
1. the twink version, which slims down Sam's jawline a little, or
2. the regular version, which only changes Sam's hair and eyes.
I would have made this a config, but I don't know how to do that. Probably don't download both versions at once.

-------

I don't plan on ever making a seasonal version of this, but if anyone else wants to, my assets are free to use! Just please credit me and let me know if you use my assets for any reason :-) I would love to see what you do with them!

-------

This is my first Stardew Valley mod, so be sure to drop any suggestions or problems you have.

This should change all of Sam's portraits, including the beach ones, so if you find any that for some reason aren't changed please let me know.


Not compatible with any other mods that change Sam's portraits.

Downloads.Description:
Slims down Sam's jawline a bit, in addition to changing his hair and eyes.
